description: What merger contracts say the parties owe, from ten years of SEC merger proxies (DEFM14A): the target's termination fee, the buyer's reverse termination fee, committed debt financing, expense caps and each executive's golden-parachute total, each with the proxy's own sentence. Argument: company (name, ticker or CIK; optional). Without it, counts and the largest fees.
name: get_deal_terms
title: deal terms
